resources.string: The router doesn\'t know the time zone %1$s. Pick it by hand in LuCI (System → System).
The router didn\'t take that zone\'s time (%1$s), so it was left as it was.
The time zone changed, but the router didn\'t reload the schedule rules: they may be off. Save any profile again to reload them.
The router didn\'t load the changes (firewall or DNS), so the previous settings were restored.
The router won\'t let the app save the parental control rules. Is the full LuCI installed?
The family DNS (%1$s) doesn\'t answer from the router, so the filter wasn\'t turned on. Try another level or check whether your internet provider blocks it.
The family DNS (%1$s) doesn\'t answer from the router, so the filter wasn\'t turned on. Check whether your internet provider blocks it.
The family DNS isn\'t filtering from your router: your internet provider seems to intercept DNS queries. The filter wasn\'t turned on.
The router has another change waiting to be confirmed (maybe from LuCI or another phone). Wait a minute and try again.
Parental control on this router was set up by a newer version of WrtControl. Update the app to change it from this phone; until then, you can only view it.
The change couldn\'t be verified and the router didn\'t confirm it was undone. Check how things were left before trying again.
The firewall\'s LAN zone wasn\'t found, so the content filter can\'t be applied. Check the firewall zones in LuCI.
The home network zone wasn\'t found in the firewall, so quarantine can\'t be turned on. Check the firewall zones in LuCI.
Approve at least one device before turning on quarantine.
Give the profile a name (without quotes).
The device %1$s is in two profiles (%2$s and %3$s): remove it from one.
Each schedule needs at least one day.
There are too many profiles with a filter (at most %1$d).
